properties.name: Mulki Marine Ecological Reserve & Buffer (Mock)
properties.authority: Department of Forest, Ecology and Environment, Govt of Karnataka (Mock)
properties.description: Designated ecologically sensitive marine breeding ground and coral habitat buffer.
properties.legal_notice: Commercial mechanized and trawler fishing strictly prohibited under Wildlife Protection Act Section 35(6). Violators subject to boat impoundment and penal prosecution.

properties.name: NMPT Port Approach & Security Corridor
properties.authority: Directorate General of Shipping / Indian Coast Guard (Mock)
properties.description: Deep draft navigational channel and security fairway for commercial container vessels and oil tankers.
properties.legal_notice: Static net setting and artisanal fishing strictly banned inside the fairway to prevent maritime collisions.
